checks: Confirm the review window (2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30) and the last IDT review date, then pull all encounters in the window: ED visits, urgent care, hospital admissions, and observation stays, with discharge summaries reviewed.
Falls and near-falls check: any fall, fall-related injury, or syncope in the window, given age 89 on antihypertensive and anti-anginal therapy. Note orthostatic blood pressure if recorded.

Medication reconciliation: lisinopril 10 mg (started 2026-07-31) and simvastatin 10 mg (started 2026-08-07) are recent starts. Confirm they were taken as prescribed, check whether simvastatin 20 mg (2011) was stopped or is a duplicate with the 10 mg entry, and flag the duplicate simvastatin strengths for prescriber clarification.
Check for any other medication starts, stops, or dose changes in the window, including clopidogrel, metoprolol succinate, and nitroglycerin use frequency (PRN spray use may indicate angina activity).

Blood pressure trend since lisinopril start: review home and clinic readings, symptoms of hypotension or dizziness, and potassium and creatinine if drawn after ACE inhibitor initiation. Flag for prescriber review rather than adjusting.
Bleeding and anemia check: review hemoglobin/CBC results given anemia and leukemia history, plus clopidogrel use, and any reported bleeding, bruising, or melena.
Leukemia and hematology follow-up: confirm oncology/hematology visits, labs, and any treatment-related changes in the window, and whether follow-up is due.
Cardiac status: review ischemic heart disease symptoms (chest pain, dyspnea, exertional tolerance), any cardiology visits, and lipid panel timing relative to the simvastatin change.
Weight and BMI trend (BMI 30+ history, metabolic syndrome, prediabetes): compare recorded weights across the window and the prior review; check glucose or HbA1c if due.

Function, cognition, mood, and caregiver: review ADL/IADL changes, cognitive screen results, mood and attendance at program activities, caregiver availability and strain, and any care-plan items due by the review date (2026-11-30). Note the aspirin allergy (abdominal pain) is on file and confirm it is reflected in the active medication list.
